items.headline:
The purchasing power of $100 since the U.S. abolished the gold standard:

1971: $100.00
1981: $44.55
1991: $29.74
2001: $22.87
2011: $18.00
2021: $14.95
2026: $12.13

The U.S. dollar has lost 88% of its purchasing power.
